scaler.formula: mean_ = data[:717].mean(axis=0); scale_ = data[:717].std(axis=0) + 1e-8 (population std ddof=0)
scaler.reproduced: fresh fit_from_train == persisted data/scaler_miflu_national.json exactly (mean diff=0.0, scale diff=0.0)
scaler.consistency_guard: load_scaler() re-fits from train and asserts fresh stats == persisted (assert_consistent_with, rtol 1e-5) -> PASS
scaler.self_check: data_pipeline._self_check asserts scaler.train_end==717 and scaler.val_end==819 -> PASS

validation_test_influence: none. Scaler is fit from data[:717] only; Validation (717..818) and Test (819..1024) rows are never seen by fit.
missing_value_imputation: not applicable (raw national_illness_raw.csv has no NaN in the 7 feature columns)
feature_stats_in_prompts: train-only by construction (NLinear has no text/prompt branch, text_encoder=none)
inverse_transform: shared by truth and prediction: y_physical = z * scale + mean (same mean/scale for both)
truth_roundtrip: y_true_physical == raw ILITOTAL exactly (max|d| = 0.0039, float32 rounding only)

input_crosses_split_boundary.note: A Test target's 104-week input window may include trailing Validation weeks and Test timestamp 819 as CONTEXT. The target starts strictly AFTER the input ends (input=[origin, origin+103], target starts at origin+104). This is legal historical context, not leakage.
